scope: Fully coated sheet-metal seating, prepaint clearance bores, fitted front shim and M3 washer interfaces. Root separately verifies live-document preservation and complete packaging.
geometry_status: No unresolved actionable finding in this bounded source/formed-cache review; physical process acceptance remains required.

bearing.method: Exact circular interval integration;10degree angular sweep is a sampled lower-area search, not analytic optimization
bearing.bound_method: Circle/stripe cap loss and maximum eccentric circle-to-annulus overlap subtracted separately; more conservative than sampled simultaneous placements.

m3x8_screw_clearance.scope: Actual pre-change populated348 visible solid bboxes; proposed washers and lower front axes. Bounding boxes certify separation; base/lid and their existing M3 screws intentionally excluded. Added shims/washer are intended contacts. Printed screen/collar changes under0.2mm are covered by0.6mm inflation. Not a cable-routing or torque proof.

verification.command: python -m unittest test_manufacturing_fit -v (from hardware/enclosure/tests using project CAD environment)
actual_cache_assembly_checks: All18 washer axes on actual formed bores; actual bearing planes; no washer/lid intersection
Nine front packs seated between actual base/lid faces with at least16mm2 supported bearing per face
Negative displaced shim and bracket cases rejected
Strict current native-flat parity, hole signatures and changed/altered native-cache rejection
Former too-small apertures and straight disc bore fail independent supplier/native fit scenarios

limits: 60–100um cured film locally, clearance bore walls included; completed M3 threads must remain functional under root-approved process
Stock and position tolerances, bare match-fit, both-end centering and all18 screws started loosely are required
Actual printed lens size, film build at edges, painting-cycle distortion, shim thickness and felt compression must be checked on actual parts
Geometric bearing area does not qualify preload, thin aluminum tapped-thread strength, coating creep or repeated foot-load performance
No planned drilling, tapping or reaming after coating; screw length range7.8–8.3mm checked geometrically, actual wire routing remains an owner assembly check
